carryOverValidation: Manual DAW PDC null test with Neural enabled vs bypassed (P13A pending)

findings.title: Missing ScopedNoDenormals in processBlock DSP scope
findings.evidence: grep ScopedNoDenormals Source/Effects/Pedals: absent from DelayPedal/ChorusPedal/FlangerPedal processBlock bodies. ProcessorBase guard is scoped to beginBypassProcess/endBypassProcess only; ProcessorBase.h:200 comment explicitly requires derived processors to add their own. Decaying feedback tails generate denormals; CPU spikes possible on hosts without global FTZ/DAZ.
findings.recommendedFix: Add 'juce::ScopedNoDenormals noDenormals;' at the top of each processBlock after the bypass gate (3 one-line changes).

findings.title: No NaN/Inf input scrub; NaN latches permanently in biquad and feedback state
findings.evidence: ChorusPedal::processBlock has no scrubInvalidSamples (Delay/Flanger/Neural scrub, Reverb fully sanitizes). tanh(NaN)=NaN, so feedbackState and biquad z1/z2 hold NaN until reset. Engine auto-heal (CORRUPT_BLOCKS_BEFORE_HEAL=2) recovers at the cost of an audible dropout and full graph state loss.
findings.recommendedFix: Add the scrubInvalidSamples helper used by FlangerPedal.h:533, plus a NaN-abuse unit test mirroring the Delay/Flanger quartet.

findings.title: No NaN/Inf input scrub; NaN latches in filters, envelopes, and PeriodTracker history
findings.evidence: OctavePedal::processBlock lacks input scrub; same NaN-latch pattern as Chorus across ~14 biquads, 2 envelope followers, and the 768-sample tracker history.
findings.recommendedFix: Add the same scrub helper and a NaN-abuse test.

findings.title: Unused Engine::processSample diverges from processBlock safety clamps
findings.evidence: Engine::processSample (ReverbPedal.h:1089) duplicates processBlock (:1255) but lacks the per-line softCeiling(x, 1.15f) clamp present at :1349. The pedal only calls processBlock; the dead path is a maintenance/divergence trap.
findings.recommendedFix: Delete processSample or align it exactly with processBlock.

findings.title: Bypass truncates tails by design; behavior undocumented for users, no trails mode
findings.evidence: ProcessorBase.h:230-236: wet engine is not rendered while bypassed and reset() runs on un-bypass so stale tails never jump back in. Intentional and commented, but musicians commonly expect delay/reverb spillover through bypass.
findings.recommendedFix: Document the behavior; optionally design a 'trails' bypass mode in a later phase (touches bypass architecture - not in this phase).
findings.implementer: Product decision; implementation Codex 5.5 if approved

findings.title: Per-sample coefficient recomputation CPU hotspots
findings.evidence: Neural: updateToneModel once per base-rate sample = 7 exp-based setCutoff calls/sample (NeuralPedal.h:305-313). Reverb: outputTone setCutoff = 2 exp/sample (ReverbPedal.h:1277). Delay: per-sample getModeStyle + std::pow + feedback biquad rebuild every 8 samples. All bounded and correct; pure CPU headroom risk.
findings.recommendedFix: Profile first; then rate-limit coefficient updates to block edges or N-sample intervals with smoothing.

findings.title: Neural pedal contains no RTNeural inference despite documentation claim
findings.evidence: grep RTNeural Source/Effects returns nothing. NeuralPedal is an analytic two-stage waveshaper (denseClip/silkyClip) with envelope sag at 8x oversampling. CLAUDE.md states 'Neural/ uses RTNeural inference for neural amp modeling'. Vendored RTNeural/Eigen/xsimd/models are unused by this pedal.
findings.recommendedFix: Correct CLAUDE.md (and any user-facing naming/claims), or wire an actual RTNeural model as a separate feature task.
findings.implementer: Doc fix: Codex 5.5; model integration: separate phase

findings.title: FDN line lengths change instantly during size/mode automation (possible zipper/clicks)
findings.evidence: configure() calls lines[i].setLength on any size/mode delta > 1e-4, firing throughout a knob sweep; read-pointer jumps can zipper. P7H automation tests assert boundedness, not click-freedom.
findings.recommendedFix: Only if listening test L7 confirms audible artifacts: crossfade or slew line-length changes.

findings.title: Pedal removal mid-tail: gap/click behavior unverified by ear
findings.evidence: Node destruction on graph publish cuts the tail instantly; STARTUP_COUNTER_GRAPH_CHANGE=6 mutes the swap. Whether the result is a clean gap or a click is unverified.
findings.recommendedFix: Manual listening item L8 only; no code change proposed.
